title: Force Carriers
definition: Force carriers are elementary particles (gauge bosons) that mediate physical forces and interactions between fundamental matter particles (fermions) within the Standard Model of particle physics.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC Civil Services Examination (GS Paper III - Science and Technology: Space, Nuclear Physics, and Emerging Technologies) as questions frequently test fundamental particle physics concepts, discoveries at CERN, and the unification of fundamental forces.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Force Carriers and gauge bosons.
Evaluate spatial distribution of particle accelerators, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on fundamental forces.
